stop_fill_convention.rule: a stop fills at the worse of (stop price, bar open) whenever the bar's open already gapped through the stop; otherwise fills at the stop price. If both a stop and a profit target are inside one bar's high-low range, the stop is assumed to hit first.
stop_fill_convention.sensitivity_row_required: one run under the optimistic same-bar-favourable-fill convention, reported as a labelled sensitivity row, never as the headline

causal_construction_assertions.design_D_correlation_graph: unit test in tests/test_exec_lib13.py perturbs bars after each rebalance date and asserts the adjacency matrix used at that rebalance is unchanged

FF.fires_if: block-bootstrap 95% CI on net Sharpe (round_turn_cost_per_contract headline) excludes zero AND DSR>=0.95 at n_trials=18 AND |beta to spot GC=F| < 0.15 AND sign stable across all four origin offsets (0/7/14/21)

SQ.fires_if: best architecture's median-across->=5-seeds net Sharpe beats the linear baseline's, paired block-bootstrap CI on the difference excludes zero, AND the level clears the sec3 bar (net Sharpe CI excl. 0, DSR>=0.95, stable sign across offsets, beats buy-and-hold/random-dollar-neutral null with paired CI excl. 0)
SQ.note: clearing the absolute bar while tying the linear baseline is a null for this design's actual claim and must be reported as one even if the absolute bar is cleared

AT.fires_if: net Sharpe clears sec3 bar AND adaptive beats frozen-parameter twin on paired CI excl. 0 AND at least 3 of 4 ablations move in the sign the design predicts

XS.fires_if: dollar-neutral book's net Sharpe clears sec3 bar AND cross-sectional IC passes 003's survival filter (|NW t|>3 and consistent sign across years) AND beta to equal_weight_basket_returns < 0.2

TGT.fires_if: any design reaches net Sharpe >= 2.0 on its dev window under the headline cost model, DSR>=0.95 at n_trials=18, AND passes the Phase L look-ahead audit
TGT.always_report: the best net Sharpe achieved across all four designs is written into the results file whether or not this gate fires

TM.fires_if: no-time-mixing variant has significantly higher cross-sectional IC than the time-mixing variant, bootstrap CI on the difference excluding zero
TM.note: pure science gate, decoupled from tradability

phase_L_audit_trigger: any design's dev-window net Sharpe >= 1.5 is treated as a suspected defect and must pass the look-ahead audit (stop-fill re-check, causal-construction re-check, single-instrument exclusion, survivorship with/without LUNA+FTT, origin-offset perturbation-not-vacuity check) before being written into 013's results file as a result rather than a suspected defect.

n_trials.counting_rule: seeds within an architecture (Design B) are one trial each because the median was pre-declared as the estimator here, before any seed was run. This number is not revised downward after seeing results.

single_instrument_and_offset_checks.single_symbol_exclusion: alpha_lib7's single-symbol exclusion check applied to every portfolio-level number in Designs C and D, and to per-fold contributions in B
single_instrument_and_offset_checks.origin_offset_vacuity_check: before reporting agreement across the four offsets as robustness, confirm the offsets actually perturb book composition/turnover (012's offset leg was found nearly vacuous)

scope: one notebook src/research/013_*.ipynb, one results file src/results/013_*.md, machinery in src/research/tmp/exec_lib13.py, tests in tests/test_exec_lib13.py. No fifth design. No universe extension past what is declared here to make a gate fire. No tuning toward the sec0 reported targets -- report whatever net Sharpe results, including near zero.
